WHY US?

Global standards, Local expertise

List of Why you should use us

  • Pan-African support:

    CyberLab Africa provides cyber threat intelligence in Nigeria, Kenya, Benin Republic, Togo, Ghana, Angola, Morocco, Ethiopia, Tanzania, Kenya, Uganda, Rwanda, Central Africa, Senegal, and Cameroon.

    Don’t see your country here? Contact us here.

  • Total brand protection:

    Designed to complete your cyber defense and provide total brand protection, CyberLab Africa’s cyber threat intelligence allows you to detect negative discussions on various social media platforms or forums and protect from stolen credentials, typo squatting domains, company imposters, phishing websites, data leakage and more.

  • Global standards, Local expertise

    Nigeria for example has over 500 languages. Our Cyber threat Intelligence analysts know where to look, and in what language (local dialects and even pidgin English) to search for threats and vulnerabilities.

    We understand crime motivators, cyber-criminal behavior as well as the mindset of various cyber-criminals in order to identify the crime chain. We also use international-grade platforms that crawl for information around the globe - looking for Africa-specific threats.

  • Next generation digital defense platform:

    At CyberLab Africa, we have developed a unique cyber threat intelligence platform that is specifically designed for the African cyberspace that knows exactly where and what to look for. Our analysts use it to gain criminals’ trust in order to manufacture gold intelligence that produces real results, such as helping local law enforcement prevent crimes as well as minimizing and solving fraud cases.

OUR PLATFORM

The next generation digital defence platform

  • Invisible
  • Actionable
  • Real-time
  • Everywhere
  • Cyber criminals are not aware of our presence. The platform spies and collects valuable information, keeping analysts hidden while providing them with full control and the liberty to do everything in their power to find and neutralize threats.
  • Receive real-time alerts and reports for your cyber defense and IT teams. Get notified about risk status, level and components.
  • Mitigate cyber-attacks and make the necessary adjustments to the organization's security systems and procedures. Configure and adapt security measures as well as implement new technologies
  • From social networks, to the deep web and dark web, CyberLab Africa is creating and collecting valuable intelligence that reproduces real results

OUR SERVICES

Fight cybercrime with our intelligence services:

  • Cyber Threat Intelligence subscription service

    The subscription service includes 24/7/365 Cyber Threat Intelligence analysts that operate, gather data, and analyze the world wide web, underground forum and markets, social media activities as well as the darknet to provide you with actionable intelligence. Our research is also around your industry-specific malicious activity, that you can use these insights to protect your organization before it happens to you.

    A few of our service you will get are:

    1. 24/7/365 immediate alerts of Cyber Threat Intelligence about your organization
    2. On-demand immediate alerts and reports of the Cyber Threat Intelligence status of your organization and your
    3. Monthly report of Cyber Threat Intelligence status of your organization and your industry
  • One Time status report

    One Time status report of Cyber Threat Intelligence about your current organization situation and all historical information that available on the internet, social media, and darknet. The report will cover how your brand, your digital assets, and business affected information on how its represented in the underground Internet market.

  • Subscription service of IOC's Feed

    Daily basis of automatic feeding API to your SIEM (Security Information and Event management) solution of Indicator Of Compromise (IOC) objects data, as a botnet, phishing and malicious domains, URLs, IPs, Hashs and more.

  • Cyber Threat Intelligence Investigation

    For cases of cyber involve activity as fraud, blackmail, leak of sensitive data, impersonation, illegal use of your products/service, reputation damage, and more, our team with our Intelligence technology can provide ad hoc investigation in forensically sounds method in order to assist your legal steps.

  • Signals Intelligence For Law Enforcement

    Our added value is years of experience on the continent signal’s infrastructure, contact us for more details

  • Intelligence Capacity building For Law Enforcement

    Cyber Threat Intelligence UNITs capacity building , including advisory, implementation of Intelligence technology in national scale, training and hand by hand capacity building.
